pages.quiz:
INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How should you sit when you write? (1 mark)
   A. Standing on the chair
   B. Lying on the desk
   C. With your back turned
   D. Straight, with your book in front of you

2. What should you keep in mind when scanning? (1 mark)
   A. A song
   B. Nothing
   C. What you are looking for
   D. A poem

3. Tall letters such as b and d usually reach (1 mark)
   A. the bottom of the page
   B. below the base line
   C. the edge of the desk
   D. the top line

4. What should you do before buying a product that an advert says is the best in the world? (1 mark)
   A. Believe everything
   B. Send money to a stranger
   C. Buy it at once
   D. Check it and the price

5. Why might a class record narrations on a device? (1 mark)
   A. To sell them
   B. To waste time
   C. To listen back and improve
   D. To erase them

6. Which word in Bring the clothes inside is the verb? (1 mark)
   A. clothes
   B. inside
   C. the
   D. Bring

7. What kind of word is when in When I arrived, the shop was closed? (1 mark)
   A. A number
   B. A conjunction
   C. An adjective
   D. A noun

8. What are the two main parts of a sentence? (1 mark)
   A. Capital and full stop
   B. Title and ending
   C. Noun and verb only
   D. Subject and predicate

9. What does the lead of a news item give? (1 mark)
   A. The ending
   B. A joke
   C. A poem
   D. The main facts

10. What should you do to check if your instructions are clear? (1 mark)
   A. Ask someone to follow them
   B. Tear them
   C. Read them backwards
   D. Hide them

11. In the story of Otieno, what caused his burn? (1 mark)
   A. He touched the handle of the hot pot
   B. He ate hot food
   C. He fell from a tree
   D. He played with a dog

12. Which is an example of caring for an animal? (1 mark)
   A. Leaving it without shelter
   B. Throwing stones at it
   C. Giving clean water every day
   D. Beating it

13. What does the English proverb Look before you leap teach? (1 mark)
   A. Look at the floor
   B. Jump quickly
   C. Think before you act
   D. Never move

14. Which sentence has a plural noun? (1 mark)
   A. Mother buys one mango.
   B. Mother buys three bananas.
   C. Mother buys sugar.
   D. Mother buys a banana.

15. Which instruction is clearer? (1 mark)
   A. Do the thing.
   B. Go and do it.
   C. Put it there.
   D. Put the bucket under the roof to collect rain water.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. What is a vocabulary bank and why is it useful? (2 marks)

17. Describe how a newsreader should read a weather bulletin. (4 marks)

18. Explain what a form is. (2 marks)

19. Describe three rules for writing tidily on lined paper. (3 marks)

20. What is a paragraph and what is its main idea? (2 marks)

21. Describe what a written dialogue shows. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
INDIGENOUS LANGUAGES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — Straight, with your book in front of you
   Good posture helps neat writing.

2. C — What you are looking for
   Scanning needs a target.

3. D — the top line
   Tall letters go up to the top line.

4. D — Check it and the price
   Adverts try to persuade so we check.

5. C — To listen back and improve
   Recordings show what to improve.

6. D — Bring
   Bring shows the action.

7. B — A conjunction
   When joins two ideas by time.

8. D — Subject and predicate
   Every sentence has a subject and a predicate.

9. D — The main facts
   The lead gives the key facts.

10. A — Ask someone to follow them
   Testing shows whether they work.

11. A — He touched the handle of the hot pot
   He moved closer and touched the handle, and the pot tipped.

12. C — Giving clean water every day
   Water and shelter meet its needs.

13. C — Think before you act
   It advises careful thought before doing something.

14. B — Mother buys three bananas.
   Bananas is plural, and the number three shows there are more than one.

15. D — Put the bucket under the roof to collect rain water.
   It says what, where and why.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: It is a class list of words on one theme. It helps pupils remember and use new words.
   Working / marking points: One mark for the meaning and one for the use.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Speak clearly, keep a steady pace, use a friendly and confident tone, pause at full stops and look at the audience.
   Working / marking points: One mark for each of four correct points.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: A form is a page with spaces where people write information in an organised way.
   Working / marking points: One mark for a page with spaces and one for collecting information.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Letters sit on the base line, tall letters reach the top line, keep a finger space between words, and start on the left.
   Working / marking points: One mark for each rule, up to three.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: A paragraph is a group of sentences about one topic. The main idea is what it is mostly about.
   Working / marking points: One mark for each part.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: A dialogue is a conversation between two or more people written to show what each speaker says.
   Working / marking points: One mark for conversation and one for showing speakers' words.
